blocks.text: Real-world analogue: A hospital recovery ward, circular archive reading room, conservation laboratory, observatory control chamber, cleanroom, and hospice combined without copying any one institution literally.

World relation: Continuity World restoration ethics joined to Crafted World clinical architecture. Quiet World restraint appears in the absence of suggestive decoration and in limits on premature inspection.
Connection to newer locations: The House connects to the Glacial Memory Fjord, Salt Mirror Archive, River of Deferred Reflections, Valley That Restores Wrong, and Museum of Unfinished Rooms.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: Restoration is not manufacturing a replacement object. A careful return must leave room for the returned person to disagree with the archive and for an unexpected continuity to possess rights of its own.
